user.title: EZVIZ Cloud Push
user.description:
Configure the EZVIZ Cloud Push integration.

Set up a webhook ID. After setup, configure this URL in EZVIZ cloud:

`{webhook_url}`

init.description: Optional: map device faceId codes to person names. Replace the example with your real values.

data_description.face_mapping:
One `faceId:name` per entry, separated by commas or newlines.

Example:
`1a2b3c:爸爸, 4d5e6f:妈妈`
